name: Copenhagen Lounge Chair
description: Elegant wooden frame lounge chair with plush cushions and supportive backrest. Features organic curves and natural materials for a timeless Scandinavian appeal.

name: Orbital Coffee Table
description: Round glass-top coffee table with concentric metal rings forming the base. The futuristic design creates a floating illusion while remaining functional.

name: Kyoto Platform Bed
description: Low profile solid wood bed frame with integrated nightstands. Minimalist design emphasizes clean lines and natural wood grain patterns.

name: Eames-Inspired Recliner
description: Leather and bent plywood recliner with matching ottoman. The iconic silhouette combines comfort with architectural principles.

name: Mumbai Storage Cabinet
description: Hand-carved wooden cabinet with intricate geometric patterns and brass hardware. Features adjustable shelving and hidden compartments.

name: Berlin Modular Sofa
description: Contemporary modular sectional with multiple configuration options. Clean lines and neutral upholstery make it adaptable to various interior schemes.

name: Acapulco Dining Table
description: Solid oak dining table with hairpin metal legs. The contrast between natural wood top and industrial supports creates a balanced statement piece.

name: Vienna Rococo Armchair
description: Ornate hand-carved frame with velvet upholstery and decorative gold leaf details. The curved arms and cabriole legs embody classical European craftsmanship.

name: Shanghai Room Divider
description: Three-panel folding screen with bamboo frame and translucent rice paper inserts. Traditional craftsmanship meets modern functionality.

name: Marrakech Floor Lamp
description: Handcrafted metal lamp with intricate cutout patterns that cast decorative shadows. The antiqued brass finish adds warmth to any space.
